profiles.title: Small Area Summary
profiles.whenToUse: Use for prompts such as 'What do you know about that OA?', 'Tell me about LSOA E01009617', or 'Give me a quick profile of the postcode area around CV3 1HB'.
steps: Pass id directly when the user already has an OA/LSOA/MSOA/parish/ward/district/region/country code.
Pass postcode or uprn when the user is anchoring from an address or postcode; default targetLevel to OA unless the prompt asks for a larger geography.
Prefer inventoryResponseMode='summary' or 'counts' for narrative summaries; do not pull full raw inventories unless the user explicitly asks for detailed UPRNs or buildings.
Use profileDatasets from the response for deeper NOMIS follow-up questions by topic.
guardrails: Do not call os_map.inventory in full mode for summary-only prompts.
Avoid admin_lookup.find_by_name when the prior step already returned a concrete OA/LSOA/MSOA/PARISH code.
Keep raw ONS fields accessible when OAC or source classifications may matter.
promptPatterns: What do you know about that OA?
Give me a quick profile of LSOA E01009617
Tell me about this postcode area CV3 1HB

evaluationTrace.userPrompt: What do you know about that OA
passCriteria: The tool call stays compact and in-band.
The response includes resolved area identity, compact counts, and curated follow-up dataset hints.
No large raw inventory payload is fetched unless the user later asks for detail.
